_course_id_comment: Either the numeric Canvas id from the course URL, or RU's SIS id such as "DCS-T-101-HOFI:41057:20263". These are different identifiers; the script accepts both. Run  fetch_roster.py courses  to see them side by side.
_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill it in. config.json is gitignored. Do NOT put the token here if you can avoid it: store it in the macOS Keychain instead, with  security add-generic-password -a "$USER" -s hofi-canvas -w  which the script reads automatically. canvas_token below is only a last-resort fallback.
